column1: # Real models for the player, every enemy and every boss (presentation only - the sim never reads this).
# id: "player", an enemies.tsv id or a bosses.tsv id (rules.gd checks every one has a row).
# model: glTF under res://assets/models/ ("-" = stand-in). Kenney Blocky Characters 2.0, CC0 (License.txt beside it).
# scale: size multiplier (models are 2.7 m tall; enemies are also scaled by their size in enemies.tsv).
# yaw: degrees to turn it so it faces down the road toward the player (-z). anim: looping clip to play.
